selectionContract.harness: The user selects exactly one harness by CLI option or persisted CLI configuration.
selectionContract.auth: An adapter auth profile selects one credential route. Prime and OMP harness-login keeps the ordinary HOME-backed store; each environment-key route receives a fresh runner-owned private config directory. Their preflight auth readiness remains unknown and the actual run is the first authentication authority. Harness-owned caches, keychains, provider routing, and upstream billing identity remain outside functional-alpha control.
selectionContract.billing: Every adapter in this contract is bring-your-own and billed through the user's harness-managed account or provider route; functional alpha does not independently prove which harness-owned credential was charged.
selectionContract.noFallback: The wrapper never changes harness or injects another credential environment group after discovery, version, auth, launch, protocol, terminal, cancellation, or timeout failure. Harness-owned credential/provider fallback is outside functional-alpha control.
selectionContract.languageBoundary: Adapters transport image and task bytes and recover the image-declared terminal; they do not parse or implement OpenProse.

taskEvidence.terminalVerification: The runner requires terminal task.argv to equal its original argv exactly.
taskEvidence.digestAuthority: The runner retains its independently computed digest of the unchanged task envelope; the model neither receives nor produces that digest.

terminalExtraction.rule: The final nonblank line must parse as exactly the image-declared closed terminal envelope.

adapters.harnessTerminal: correlated prompt acknowledgement, then one closed no-tool agent/turn/user/assistant/turn_end lifecycle, then terminal agent_end followed by process exit 0 after stdin close
